up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows from the ChEMBL database meeting the following criteria: The assay must target the protein with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL332' (Interstitial collagenase), which is a single-protein target from Homo sapiens. The activity type must be 'IC50' and the row must have a defined pChEMBL value (pchembl_value IS NOT NULL). Return the following columns: the assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), the target type (target_dictionary.target_type), the taxonomy ID (target_dictionary.tax_id), the canonical SMILES of the molecule (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the standard activity type (activities.standard_type), and the pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID and then by the assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass
  ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td
  ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md
  ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs
  ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL332'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
